title: crassula × affinis
intro: Crassula × affinis, commonly known as the Jade Plant or Friendship Tree, is a hybrid succulent plant resulting from the cross between Crassula ovata and Crassula arborescens. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its potential to improve air quality by removing pollutants and toxins, as well as its ability to boost the immune system and reduce stress levels. The therapeutic actions of Crassula × affinis include its anxiolytic and antidepressant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
